newsitem.title: USA: Quadrax names Brooks Herrick CFO.
newsitem.headline: Quadrax names Brooks Herrick CFO.

text.p: Quadrax Corp said Wednesday it has named Brooks Herrick as chief financial officer.
Herrick replaces Edward Stoltenberg, who has decided to pursue other interests outside of Quadrax, the company said.

Herrick has over 30 years of finance and accounting experience, most recently as vice president of finance and corporate controller at Amtrol Inc, Warwick, R.I.-based manufacturer of water systems, Quadrax said.
Previous to Amtrol, Herrick also served in a similar role at Damon Corp, a clinical laboratory.

Quadrax produces thermoplastic composite materials that are used in commercial and consumer products including golf club shafts, hockey stick shafts, lacrosse stick shafts, mountain bike handle bars and bicycle wheel components.
